##


## Reduce Supply Chain Friction Through Greater Integration


As advanced therapy programs move from clinical stages to commercialization, their operations become more complex and exposed to potential risks and friction in the supply chain. More products, materials, sites, and stakeholders must be coordinated, making continuity and visibility across the supply chain increasingly important. An integrated approach can help reduce handoff points, simply coordination, and mitigate risks that can lead to delays, errors, and added costs.


Cryoport Systems supports cell and gene therapy programs across the supply chain, bringing together specialized logistics, biostorage, kitting, packaging, and consulting and advisory services within a connected supply chain framework. This approach helps organizations maintain greater continuity as their programs scale and their supply chain requirements evolve.


##### The Hidden Costs of Fragmented Supply Chain Models


When organizations rely on multiple vendors to transport, store, kit, package and distribute their products, it’s virtually impossible for one partner to provide centralized oversight. With a system full of disconnected capabilities, errors and deviations start to place strain on the program budget.


Another key component of an integrated supply approach is[consulting and advisory support](https://www.cryoport.com/solutions/consulting-services/) , which can provide expert guidance and proactive risk assessment. This can include shipping risk assessments and lane qualifications to identity and address potential risks before materials are in transit. Cryoport Systems offers a team of experts with years of experience and industry knowledge that properly evaluate shipping lanes and make necessary adjustments based on environmental conditions, regulatory requirements, and logistical challenges before your invaluable materials are potentially at risk. Without these detailed evaluations, shipments are exposed to delays and failures that not only add pressure to cost resources but can also impact the quality of the sensitive materials in transit.


An additional benefit of advisory support is packaging validation. Our teams ensure that all shippers are rigorously tested and validated to ensure your sensitive materials are protected from conditions like high temperatures, humidity, or physical stress. They will undergo examinations for effective insulation, temperature retention, and structural integrity to meet industry standards and regulations. We also follow a Chain of Compliance® to track shipment status and history with full traceability of the package, including detailed documentation of equipment history, commodity condition, calibration records, and in-field data.


Without the support of coordinated team of experienced experts, your supply chain system may not only be fragmented but also lack oversight and the ability to intervene during any step of the process. The cost of this disconnect can be steep; consider the price of extra vendor audits, lane failures, reshipments, and regulatory remediation burdens, added labor hours, and overall commercial readiness delays.


##### An Integrated Supply Chain Partnership Simplifies Execution and Improves Efficiency


Finding an experienced supply chain partner with the right framework can prevent tangled operational issues and improve performance. Ironing out these inefficiencies or avoiding them in the first place is crucial to a scalable commercial program. A unified system requires fewer handoffs between logistics, biostorage, kit production, and packaging and labeling, automates documentation flow, standardizes packaging performance, ensures qualified global lanes, harmonizes standard operating procedures (SOPs), and centralizes advisory oversight. Reducing the number of handoffs across your supply chain allows for clear ownership and accountability. Your supply chain partner can quickly resolve issues that arise in the process, instead of having to contact multiple vendors to address a problem and adjust plans based on delays or errors.


Automated documentation flow allows for better traceability of shipments during the entire supply chain process. Additionally, when you have an end-to-end supply chain partner, there is less administrative effort needed to connect all the process documentation. You can stay fully aware of your materials’ location and condition without contacting multiple vendors. And when it comes to quality assessments, all of the documentation is prepared and assembled to meet regulations.


Experienced supply chain partners offer the benefit of qualified global shipping lanes, helping commercial programs avoid shipping disruptions. Route validation and performance data is assessed ahead of time, providing more confidence and reliability as you expand into regional and global markets.


Establishing high efficiency doesn’t just mean speed. It requires the elimination of operational friction throughout every step of the process before downstream problems occur. With harmonized SOPs and governance, your supply chain partner can streamline quality assessments and operational procedures. There is constant communication and visibility, which is crucial as your program grows. With a fragmented system, the entire process is slowed down by any operational complexities that become apparent during transportation. A standardized approach from an experienced team with complete oversight is the key to commercial success.


##### Cost Avoidance Is the Most Proactive Strategy


Many advanced therapy organizations are inclined to focus on the most affordable vendor options but then realize the downside after expensive errors populate across the supply chain. Instead, the thinking should be reversed: a high-quality, experienced supply chain partner helps you avoid costly failures for the best long-term value.


The strategy should not be reactive. Meaning advanced therapy developers need to be proactive with planning, processes, documentation, and operations early in their programs. Having a unified framework from a supply chain partner that offers logistics, biostorage, kitting, drug packaging and labeling can support a more efficient program, and ultimately, lead to cost savings. These strategic wins come from audit readiness, consistent documentation, fewer scheduling disruptions and reshipments, qualified routes, packaging validation, and comprehensive advisory oversight.


Support your long-term commercial success with a connected supply chain approach. Cryoport Systems brings together specialized logistics, biostorage, kitting, packaging and labeling, and consulting and advisory services to support advanced therapy programs as they scale. By reducing handoffs and improving coordination across critical supply chain activities, an integrated approach can help mitigate risk, improve efficiency and avoid unnecessary costs.
